description: Minimal valid camt.052 Bank to Customer Account Report (Interim) with only required elements. Interim report with no transaction entries and no balances.
test_coverage: Account identification with IBAN and currency
No balance reporting (key difference from camt.053)
business_rules_expected_to_pass: CAMT052-IB01: Valid IBAN format with Mod-97 check digit
notes: This minimal interim report demonstrates the bare minimum required for a valid camt.052 message. Deutsche Bank (DEUTDEFF) is providing an interim account report for IBAN DE89370400440532013000 at 14:30 on 2026-02-10. Unlike camt.053 statements, camt.052 interim reports do NOT include opening/closing balances - they focus solely on transaction activity reporting. This minimal example has no transaction entries. This is semantically equivalent to a minimal MT942 message with only mandatory fields (20, 25, 28C).
